title: Design Bounded Blocking Queue
summary: Implement a thread-safe bounded FIFO queue of the given capacity: enqueue blocks while full, dequeue blocks while empty and returns the oldest element, and size reports the current length.
inputFormat: A positive integer capacity; enqueue takes an element; dequeue and size take no arguments.
outputFormat: dequeue returns the element; size returns an integer; enqueue returns nothing (not recorded).
edgeRules: Blocking when full or empty is stated; no element is lost or duplicated under concurrent calls.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.input: capacity 2: enqueue 1, enqueue 2, size -> 2, dequeue -> 1, enqueue 3, size -> 2
examples.note: Single-threaded validation only; blocking is not shown.

questions: Are the return types of enqueue, dequeue and size exactly as the authored sequence assumes?
